CJW_PD.title: Pitch diameter, major diameter, blank diameter: what are they? (30 November 2017)
CJW_PD.note: Thread roll maker. Blank diameter = MAX thread pitch diameter less .002 in [or .051 mm], for straight threads.

CJW_BLANK.title: Engineering bulletin: blank design (24 May 2016)
CJW_BLANK.note: Changes to the blank diameter affect the major diameter of the thread by a ratio of 3 to 1: .001 in on the blank is .003 in on the major diameter.

MH_ROLL.title: Machinery's Handbook, 31st ed. (2020), Thread rolling, 'Diameter of blank for thread rolling', p. 2188 (the publisher's online copy)
MH_ROLL.note: Read twice, same figures. The blank is about the pitch diameter; the amounts above or below it by screw size; the outside diameter grows by about the depth of one thread; verify by trial. The passage does not say whether maximum, minimum or basic pitch diameter is meant.

notes.t: Rolling raises the outside diameter by about the depth of one thread.
Verify the blank diameter by trial, especially for accurate threads; harder and tougher stock resists being displaced, so the trial size may need adjusting for the material.
A change of the blank diameter changes the rolled major diameter by about three times as much.
